milestone: Milestone 9: Scientific Diagnosis, Ablation & Publication Validation
critical_distinction: All gates PASS indicates that the scientific evaluation procedure and its required validation gates passed with 100% compliance. The empirical results themselves diagnose substantial discrimination limitations, particularly near-chance ROC-AUC values and theta=0.50 all-fake decision behavior.

gates.scientific_interpretation: M8 benchmark results were reproduced within the predefined numerical tolerance and the physical verification subset was consistent with cached inference.
Score distributions showed substantial overlap between pristine and manipulated samples; statistical tests did not establish meaningful distribution separation on the evaluated populations.
OFAT preprocessing changes produced measurable score/AUC variation on the diagnostic subset, while theta=0.50 binary decisions remained unchanged.
Valid T=16 sampling strategies were evaluated; T!=16 was correctly excluded under the frozen sequence-length contract.
Attention statistics were characterized and an inference-only uniform-pooling intervention was evaluated without modifying checkpoint weights.
Errors were characterized by dataset, threshold, manipulation family, and detector metadata using explicitly non-causal analysis.
Video-level bootstrap uncertainty and paired McNemar analyses were computed under fixed reproducibility settings.
Publication artifacts, provenance, numerical consistency, claim audit, regression tests, and checkpoint integrity were verified.
